release_notes: Visible name is Abaco Coding Harness. Mac installer is Abaco-Coding-Harness.dmg → /Applications/Abaco Coding Harness.app. 1.2.15/1.2.16 failed on v1.2.17 with “Mounted image has no Universal.app” (bundle rename). This DMG still includes Universal.app on a Universal volume so those old updaters can apply. If you are stuck on 1.2.15 or 1.2.16 you can also drag Abaco Coding Harness.app to /Applications once; after this release later auto-updates work. Python package stays universal; UNIVERSAL_* env vars unchanged.
